$comment: One mutant per pattern: the intact page plus ONE change, either a CSS block injected before </head> (`inject`) or one literal edit (`replace`). `build.mjs` writes mutants/<id>.html from these; `expect` is what check responsive must report, and `from` names the demo-site defect the mutant reproduces.

mutants.from: magazine D30: at tablet width the one-row masthead does not fit and its links wrap a character at a time
mutants.inject: @media (min-width: 560px) { .masthead__inner { flex-direction: row; align-items: center; gap: 28px; } .nav { flex-wrap: nowrap; margin-left: auto; } .search { align-self: center; } }

mutants.from: docs D24: at 768-1000px the four phase cards stay in one row inside a 432px article
constructed: a column given a fixed minimum no longer fits once the sidebar joins
dashboard D5, variant: the orders table is wider than its card; here the scroller clips instead of scrolling
shop D7: at 320px the newsletter row is 324px wide — the email field's width pushes the button past the edge
checkout D1 / D3, variant: a price column that keeps its width squeezes the item name
constructed: a hero sized to the viewport cuts its own copy on a short (landscape) screen
constructed: a fixed drawer sized in vw and pushed out in rem lands over the content beside it
fixtures/dogfood-dataviz-2026-08-11: a query bound off by one leaves exactly 768px to the desktop grid
constructed, WCAG 1.4.4: controls sized in px around text sized in rem clip it when the reader's text is larger
mutants.inject: .toolbar button { height: 2.25rem; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; height: 36px; }

mutants.from: constructed: a container query switched on before its row fits (docs noted check breakpoints cannot see container queries)
